title: 敬語とビジネスの基本
label: BJT · 第1課

screen.subject: 件名：新製品のご案内
screen.line: 高橋様が申し上げたとおり

lines.en: Hello, and welcome to Kamaru Business Japanese.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Today is lesson 1: keigo and 25 words you'll hear all the time at work.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: First, let's listen to a conversation at the office.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Suzuki, I read your email about the new product yesterday.
lines.name: 中村部長

lines.en: Thank you. I've already received a reply from Mr Takahashi at the client.
lines.name: 鈴木

lines.en: The product description and the price were both clear. But the keigo bothered me a little.
lines.name: 中村部長

lines.en: Oh — where was it?
lines.name: 鈴木

lines.en: You wrote "as Mr Takahashi 申し上げた". 申し上げる is humble language, so it's never used for a customer.
lines.name: 中村部長

lines.en: Ah, that's right. It should be "as he おっしゃった".
lines.name: 鈴木

lines.en: Exactly. And 伺います shows more respect than 行きます for "I'll come next week".
lines.name: 中村部長

lines.en: Understood. I'll fix it right away and send it again.
lines.name: 鈴木

lines.en: Now let's go through today's words one by one. First, keigo words.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Language that shows respect to the other person. There are three kinds: respectful, humble and polite.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Use correct keigo on the phone.
lines.name: 中村部長

lines.en: The feeling of valuing and looking up to someone.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We show our respect for customers through our words.
lines.name: 鈴木

lines.en: Looking up to and respecting someone.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Yamada is respected by everyone.
lines.name: 中村部長

lines.en: Lowering yourself to honour the other person.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: In Japanese business, a humble attitude matters.
lines.name: 鈴木

lines.en: Keigo that humbles your own actions to honour the other person.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: 伺う and 申し上げる are humble language.
lines.name: 中村部長

segments.meaning: to say, tell (humble of 言う)

lines.en: Humble form of 言う (to say), used for your own speech.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I thank you from the bottom of my heart.
lines.name: 鈴木

lines.en: Humble form of 行く (to go) and 聞く (to ask).
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I'll visit your company at ten tomorrow.
lines.name: 中村部長

lines.en: Humble form of もらう (to receive).
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I received advice from the department manager.
lines.name: 鈴木

segments.meaning: can receive (humble; 〜ていただけますか)

lines.en: The "can" form of いただく, used for polite requests.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Could you send us the materials by email?
lines.name: 中村部長

segments.meaning: give (honorific form of くれる, from a superior)

lines.en: Respectful form of くれる, for when someone does something for you.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Mr Takahashi kindly sent us the materials.
lines.name: 鈴木

segments.meaning: sending (お送りする / お送りいたします)

lines.en: Polite form of 送る (to send), as in お送りします.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I'll send the quote tomorrow.
lines.name: 中村部長

lines.en: The polite way to say 客 (customer).
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: This way, please (to a customer).
lines.name: 鈴木

lines.en: Next, words for doing business.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Work and commerce.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Business emails have a set format.
lines.name: 中村部長

lines.en: Companies exchanging goods or money with each other.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We've done business with that company for over ten years.
lines.name: 鈴木

lines.en: A company you do business with.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: This afternoon I have a meeting with a client.
lines.name: 中村部長

lines.en: Customers who buy your products or services.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We use customer feedback in our new services.
lines.name: 鈴木

lines.en: Last, words for products and sales.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Things made to be sold.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: This product is popular with young people.
lines.name: 中村部長

lines.en: Things manufactured, for example in a factory.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Our company's products are used overseas too.
lines.name: 鈴木

lines.en: A newly made product.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We plan to announce a new product next month.
lines.name: 中村部長

lines.en: The price of something.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The price is 3,000 yen including tax.
lines.name: 鈴木

lines.en: Lowering the price.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: If you buy in bulk, we'll take 10% off.
lines.name: 中村部長

lines.en: Buying something.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Please purchase through this website.
lines.name: 鈴木

lines.en: Selling something.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Sales of the new app have started.
lines.name: 中村部長

lines.en: Something that tells many people about a product.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We put up an ad for the new product at the station.
lines.name: 鈴木

lines.en: Delivering ordered goods to the customer.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Delivery will be next Friday.
lines.name: 中村部長

lines.en: Finally, let's check with a quiz. Choose the answer from 1 to 4.
lines.name: ナレーター

segments.promptEn: I'll ___ your company at ten tomorrow.

lines.en: Question 1. Which word goes in the brackets?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 2: 伺います, I'll visit your company at ten tomorrow.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Question 2. Which word goes in the brackets?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 4: いただきました, we received feedback from a customer.
lines.name: ナレーター

segments.promptEn: Which is the humble form of 言う?

lines.en: Question 3. Which is the humble form of 言う?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 1: 申し上げる. おっしゃる is the respectful form.
lines.name: ナレーター

segments.promptEn: Delivering ordered goods to the customer.

lines.en: Question 4. What do you call delivering ordered goods?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 3: 納品.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Question 5. Which word goes in the brackets?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 2: 値引き, today only, 20% off everything.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Today we studied 25 keigo and business words.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Review them again in the app's word list.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Good work today. See you in the next lesson.
lines.name: ナレーター
